requirements.title: Entrar, salir y proteger la sesión
requirements.statement: WHEN a user submits a correo and a contraseña that match an active account THE system SHALL start a session for that user and show the screen of their role

requirements.title: Reservar material para unas fechas
requirements.statement: WHEN a socio without multas pendientes chooses a tipo de material and dates desde–hasta THE system SHALL create the reserva if at least one unit of that tipo is free every day of the range
